title: Mix-ins do not work for `Enum`s

labels.name: has-failing-test
labels.description: Indicates that there exists a test case (under `failing/`) to reproduce the issue

labels.name: enum
labels.description: Related to handling of Enum values

body:
1. create java enum like this
```
public enum SomeEnum {
    none,
    tax10,
    tax20
}
```

2. create mixin for enum
```
public enum  SomeEnumMixin {
    @JsonProperty("zero")
    none,
    @JsonProperty("TypTyp")
    tax10,
    @JsonProperty("PytPyt")
    tax20
}
```

3. register mixin via `.addMixIn(SomeEnum.class, SomeEnumMixin.class)`

4. try to deserialize sometithing
